user.title: Connect to MadPlan
user.description: Create a token in MadPlan under Settings, Home Assistant. The address is the MadPlan app's hostname from its Info tab, with port 8099, such as http://88efefb2-madplan:8099.

reauth_confirm.title: New token for MadPlan
reauth_confirm.description: The token was refused. Create a new one in MadPlan under Settings, Home Assistant.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach MadPlan at that address.

abort.already_configured: This MadPlan server is already set up.

shopping_cost.name: Cost of what is left to buy

add_to_shopping_list.name: Add to shopping list
add_to_shopping_list.description: Puts an item on MadPlan's current shopping list, such as from an automation.

update_pantry.name: Update pantry
update_pantry.description: Reports how much of an item is at home, such as from a sensor or a barcode scanner.

unit.name: Unit
unit.description: Such as g, l or stk.

min_quantity.name: Keep at least
min_quantity.description: Below this, MadPlan suggests buying more.

vote_meal.name: Vote on a meal
vote_meal.description: Says yes or no to a planned meal, such as from a button on a phone.

meal_id.name: Meal
meal_id.description: The meal's id, from the meals attribute of the sensor for meals to vote on.

meal_cooked.name: Meal made or not
meal_cooked.description: Says whether a meal was made. Yes takes its food out of the pantry, no puts it back.

send_to_mealie.name: Send to Mealie
send_to_mealie.description: Presses "Save and send to Mealie" for the household's current plans. Only accepted meals are sent.
